label: BAAA: special conditions for non-EU citizenship or qualifications

readerAccess.reason: Applies to non-EU citizenship OR a non-EU qualifying exam. Residence and completing school in Denmark affect the completed-exam rule; fee exemptions are separate.

fee.note: Only for fee-liable non-EU citizens after residence exemptions. Payment link still names 2026; confirm 2027 instructions. Refund only if admitted, tuition paid and still enrolled on 1 October.

milestones.label: BAAA special route: completed qualifying examination
milestones.note: Generally complete before application deadline. Exception: permanent/permanence-eligible residence (including EU citizens) while finishing high school in Denmark. Fee-liable applicants must finish before 15 March. Have BAAA assess actual status.

milestones.label: BAAA fee-liable applicants: application fee and receipt
milestones.note: EUR 150 for non-EU citizens unless exempt; confirm current payment instructions before using the old 2026 link.

milestones.label: BAAA special route: answer if no Danish residence permit
milestones.note: Annual wording is before 1 May, not a confirmed dated 2027 event; only for special-route applicants without a Danish residence permit.

milestones.label: BAAA tuition-liable applicants: first semester payment
milestones.note: Pay before the semester starts under your invoice/admission letter; exact 2027 payment date is not published on the tuition page.

submissionItems.label: Completed diploma/transcript and special-route documents
submissionItems.note: Use BAAA verification form, passport, other relevant educational degrees and residence permit/government letter if held. Non-EU documents from countries not English- or Spanish-speaking require Danish or English translation.

supplementarySteps: Qualified applicants under this route complete a clarifying online interview.
Have BAAA assess citizenship, exam country, permit class and whether you finish school in Denmark separately. Do not infer blanket exclusion of non-EU or same-year IB candidates.
